title: User Login Data Flow
scenario: A User submits login credentials to "1.0 Authenticate User". The process reads account records from "D1 Users" to verify the password and returns an authentication result back to the User.
goal: Connect the User, authentication process, and user data store to model credential submission, store lookup, and login response.
learningObjective: Distinguish reading from a Data Store (Store -> Process) from writing to one, and trace bidirectional user-process flows.
hints: Data flows are directional: the sender is the source and the receiver is the target.
1.0 Authenticate User reads stored credentials from D1 Users, so the flow goes from D1 Users to 1.0 Authenticate User.
Connect User -> 1.0 Authenticate User, D1 Users -> 1.0 Authenticate User, and 1.0 Authenticate User -> User.
solutionExplanation: User sends credentials to 1.0 Authenticate User, which reads account records from D1 Users and returns the login result to User.

solutions.description: Authentication request, data store read, and response flow

edges.description: Process returns auth result to User
